concerns.text: The plan calls for ≥ 15 000 Monte‑Carlo iterations **per condition** (see “≥ 15 000 Monte‑Carlo iterations per condition” in the Implementation Plan). With 7 datasets × 3 missingness mechanisms × 8 missingness rates × 3 analysis methods = 504 conditions, this yields > 7.5 million iterations. Running miceforest‑based Multiple Imputation (5 imputations) and IPW for each iteration far exceeds the capacity of the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM) and the estimated 4.5 h runtime is unrealistically low. The compute load is infeasible under the platform’s free‑compute constraints.
